cds.text: Notice forms of communication such as sounds, symbols, images and objects; respond to names of objects
Attend to images, rhyme and refrains; respond to texts about personal experiences
Attend to imaginative and informative texts and visual schedules; use images to find meaning
Connect an object, image and spoken word; make sounds to communicate basic wants
Choose an image to stand for a familiar text or event
Make choices in a jointly built text; use software or apps to choose images and sounds
Use sounds, gestures and facial expressions to communicate; show a choice
Show a preferred text; join rhymes and songs and echo rhythms
Respond to simple instructions and familiar people; respond to a short presentation
Recognise objects named, signed or shown; notice differences by matching letters, images and words
Notice features such as images, rhyme and refrains; recognise a familiar event or character
Attend to texts in different settings; use images to make meaning from shared texts
Link an object, image and spoken word; use speech sounds to ask for things
Select an image to represent a familiar text or recent event
Choose an image for a short text about a special event; use software for shared texts
Use sounds, gestures, images and expressions; indicate a choice; connect sounds and words to objects
Identify a preferred text; respond to familiar images or sounds; join rhymes and songs
Respond to simple instructions and to others in familiar routines
Texts take many forms; a group of words conveys a message; objects connect to names and images
Identify features of familiar literary texts including poetry; recognise key events
Explore texts and images used in the community; use simple visual schedules; use images to find key objects and events
Symbols, words and images communicate needs; know written name and its letters; know beginning sounds of familiar words
Retell an event or familiar text using images
Make simple texts by labelling images with own writing; trace letters and patterns; use software to choose images and type labels
Recognise ways to greet people and to express needs, likes and dislikes; use words and images to request and recount
Identify a preferred image or refrain and a favourite character; repeat rhythms in rhymes and songs
Respond to adults in class; recognise when others speak in groups; add comments to a small group
Words can be spoken, written, signed or shown with symbols; statements and questions differ; capital and lower-case letters
Literary texts have characters, events, settings and rhyme; texts about familiar experiences have key events
Identify familiar texts used in the community; read a simple sentence or its picture; use images to retell or comment
Write language down; use common words and familiar sounds; copy own name; a full stop marks a pause; find beginning sounds
Retell a familiar text or event using sequenced images and simple statements
Make simple statements with symbols, letters and words; change own text in shared editing; copy letters and numbers; use software
Start and keep up greetings and short exchanges; express needs, likes and dislikes; short phrases for different purposes; sounds in words
Identify favourite texts and characters; say likes and dislikes about events; copy rhythms and sound patterns
Respond to others in classroom routines; take turns and ask simple questions; give a short talk about an object or event

rows.newText: {{S}} notices sounds, symbols, images and objects as different ways of communicating.
{{S}} looks at pictures and responds to rhymes and refrains in shared texts.
{{S}} attends to stories, information texts and visual schedules in everyday settings.
{{S}} connects an object, a picture and a spoken word and makes sounds to ask for things.
{{S}} chooses a picture to stand for a familiar story or a recent event.
{{S}} uses sounds, gestures and facial expressions to communicate with familiar people.
{{S}} shows which text {{s}} prefers and joins in rhymes and songs with familiar rhythms.
{{S}} recognises objects when they are named, signed or shown and matches familiar letters and images.
{{S}} notices pictures, rhymes and refrains in a text and recognises a familiar event or character.
{{S}} attends to texts in different places and uses pictures to make meaning from shared texts.
{{S}} links an object, a picture and a spoken word and uses sounds to ask for things.

{{S}} identifies a preferred text and responds to familiar pictures or sounds when sharing a story.
